header: Where each stage of the grid programme stands
lead: Five stages, one budget and a deadline set by the concession agreement rather than by us. Two are finished, two are running and one has not started.
note: Percentages are the project office's own assessment at the end of December 2026, not an independent survey. A stage at 0 % has been planned and funded but not begun.

metrics.title: Ashcombe substation rebuilt
metrics.text: Commissioned in March 2026, four months later than planned and within budget.

metrics.title: Deepwell 20 kV ring closed
metrics.text: Closed in September 2026. The district now has two independent feeds.

metrics.title: Marrowfield pumping station
metrics.text: Civil works finished; the pumps are expected in May 2027.

metrics.title: Old Harbour cable renewal
metrics.text: 31 of 113 km laid. Slowed by the harbour works until August 2026.

metrics.title: Stonebeck storage site
metrics.text: Planning application submitted in November 2026; construction from 2028.
